name: 3D Reference Catalogue Refresh Plan

cadence.official-documentation-and-examples: every six months or before a major build

qualityChecks: reject binary, base64, archived project and copied source content
preserve reference-only usage policy by default
verify style and interaction classifications manually
apply the semantic relevance contract before project selection
review current licence and attribution requirements before reuse
ownership: The build agent or assigned library curator records reviewer and review date.

refsGallery.policy: Respect public access controls. If the category cannot be enumerated without bypassing security or dynamic access controls, keep the source seed and report zero collected records rather than circumventing the restriction.
